column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rules for the CI web scan. Any warning or failure not listed here fails the
# build; each IGNORE says why the finding does not apply.

column3: (Re-examine Cache-control: the console's static files may be cached; API responses send no-store)
(Suspicious comments: ordinary words such as 'user' in the console's JavaScript comments; no secrets)
(Authentication request identified: informational; the sign-in form)
(Anti-CSRF tokens: the API authenticates with an Authorization header, never a cookie; forms are submitted by JavaScript as JSON)
